questions.prompt: At work, I feel mentally exhausted.
I struggle to find any enthusiasm for my work.
At work, I have trouble staying focused.
At work, I feel unable to control my emotions.
Are you exhausted in the morning at the thought of another day at work?
Do you have enough energy for family and friends during leisure time?

interpretation.low: This score suggests low burnout complaints on the BAT-4 core symptoms right now. You're showing steady balance — keep up what's working for you.
interpretation.moderate: This score suggests a moderate level of burnout complaints on the BAT-4 core symptoms. It's not a diagnosis, but it may be a good time to build in regular breaks and a bit more self-care.
interpretation.high: This score suggests elevated burnout complaints on the BAT-4 core symptoms. It is not a diagnosis, but it may indicate that current work demands are placing significant strain on your recovery, energy, and wellbeing. You may consider reaching out to HR or a mental health professional if this feels difficult to manage alone.
